screener.fundamental_data_source: Reported corporate filings and delayed End-of-Day (EOD) exchange data, updated daily after market close

fundamental_filters.name: Price-to-Earnings (P/E)
fundamental_filters.definition: Current share price divided by trailing twelve-month (TTM) earnings per share from reported financial statements.

fundamental_filters.name: Price-to-Book (P/B)
fundamental_filters.definition: Market capitalization relative to reported net book value (shareholders' equity) on the latest balance sheet.

fundamental_filters.name: EV / EBITDA
fundamental_filters.definition: Enterprise value (market cap plus total debt less cash) relative to operating earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization.

fundamental_filters.name: Return on Equity (ROE)
fundamental_filters.definition: Net profit attributable to equity shareholders divided by average shareholders' equity over the reporting period.

fundamental_filters.name: Return on Capital Employed (ROCE)
fundamental_filters.definition: Operating profit (EBIT) divided by total capital employed (total assets minus current liabilities).

fundamental_filters.name: Operating Profit Margin (OPM %)
fundamental_filters.definition: Operating profit before interest and tax expressed as a percentage of reported revenue from operations.

fundamental_filters.name: Debt-to-Equity Ratio (D/E)
fundamental_filters.definition: Total borrowings (long-term plus short-term debt) divided by total shareholders' equity.

fundamental_filters.name: Interest Coverage Ratio
fundamental_filters.definition: Operating profit (EBIT) divided by annual finance costs, measuring buffer to service debt obligations.

fundamental_filters.name: Revenue & Profit CAGR (3Y / 5Y)
fundamental_filters.definition: Compound annual growth rate of reported top-line revenue and net income across 3-year and 5-year historical windows.

fundamental_filters.name: Relative Volume & Delivery Participation
fundamental_filters.definition: End-of-day traded volume compared against 20-day and 50-day historical averages across NSE and BSE universes.
